name: extract_sumi_search2
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/sumi.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/sumi.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(r.stdout)
print('COUNTERS',(p/'search-budget.json').read_text());print((p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text());print((p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text())
plan={'queries':['"Canonical forms of small tensors" Bremner Hu journal correction','"1206.5179" conjecture orbit proof','"Canonical forms of small tensors over F2" published']}
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'search-plan2.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),'search-plan2.json'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
